name: clubmed
description: Club Med AI Guild - skills and tools shared across developer and designer teams.

plugins.name: clubmed-frontend
plugins.description: React, Next.js, GraphQL, TypeScript, testing, and design tools.

plugins.name: clubmed-backend-node
plugins.description: Node.js, API design, security, PostgreSQL, Prisma, observability, and testing.

plugins.name: clubmed-backend-python
plugins.description: Django, FastAPI, async patterns, API design, security, and databases.

plugins.name: clubmed-backend-java
plugins.description: Java 21+, Spring Boot, API design, security, and databases.

plugins.name: clubmed-infra
plugins.description: Terraform, Kubernetes, container security, and security scanning.

plugins.name: clubmed-tracking-data
plugins.description: Build and maintain tracking plans from a Figma link, a DRD (Design Requirement Details), or a live URL: infer events, auto-approve with a confidence score, validate against GTM, render a review markdown, export to Excel, PDF or Markdown.

plugins.name: clubmed-product
plugins.description: Skills for product managers and product owners: spec generation from PRDs, user story enrichment, and developer-ready documentation.

plugins.name: clubmed-docs
plugins.description: GitHub tooling: access lifecycle (PAT generation and persistence), the GitHub MCP server to read repositories, issues, and pull requests, and an end-to-end commit → rebase → push → PR workflow.

plugins.name: clubmed-qa
plugins.description: Robust Playwright/TypeScript E2E test generation: qualify the intent (reads docs/ PRDs and glossary), ground selectors on the live site, plan, write reusing existing code, prove non-flakiness by repeated cross-browser runs, and review with independent critics.
